mainEntity.name: What is the average cost of concrete hardscaping per square foot?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of concrete hardscaping per square foot varies widely depending on several factors, including the type of finish (e.g., standard broom, stamped, colored, exposed aggregate), site preparation requirements, and the overall project size. Custom designs, specialized materials, and accessibility challenges can also influence the price. We provide detailed, transparent quotes after an on-site evaluation to ensure accuracy for your specific project in the Los Angeles area.
